text:
Dallas Cowboys beat spiralling Philadelphia Eagles as Dak Prescott and Javonte Williams star amid Jalen Hurts absence
Javonte Williams put up career-high numbers as the Dallas Cowboys beat the Philadelphia Eagles, who suffered their fifth straight defeat; Tanner McKee started at quarterback for the Eagles with Jalen Hurts set to miss the rest of the season due to blood clots in his lungs
Tuesday 27 October 2026 06:39, UK
Dak Prescott threw for 212 yards and three touchdowns, two to CeeDee Lamb, as the Dallas Cowboys beat the Philadelphia Eagles 38-21 to hand Nick Sirianni's side their fifth straight loss.
Javonte Williams ran for a career-high 155 yards and a touchdown, and the Cowboys (3-4) remained in contention for the NFC East title. The New York Giants lead the division at 4-2-1.
The Eagles (2-5) are spiralling into a disaster of a season with their longest skid since 2016.
Philadelphia quarterback Jalen Hurts is expected to miss the rest of the season because of blood clots in his lungs.
Tanner McKee provided little encouragement that he can turn the season around, completing 23 of 35 passes for 211 yards with one touchdown and one interception. Prescott finished long drives with scores that McKee was unable to match.

With Dallas trailing 21-20 late in the third quarter, Lamb hauled in his second touchdown on a beautiful 16-yard floater from Prescott in the corner of the end zone. Prescott ran in the two-point conversion for a 28-21 lead.
Brandon Aubrey kicked field goals of 55, 27 and 24 yards. The final kick extended Dallas' lead to 31-21.
Williams capped the scoring and the first 150-yard rushing game by a Dallas player since Ezekiel Elliott in 2018 with a 2-yard touchdown. The Cowboys finished with 204 yards rushing.
McKee had a pass intercepted by linebacker DeMarvion Overshown late in the fourth. McKee orchestrated the first Eagles' touchdown drive in the third quarter this season when they ran almost 10 minutes off the clock and he hit rookie Makai Lemon for a 4-yard touchdown and a 21-20 lead.
The Eagles didn't score again and are running out of time to salvage their season.
The Cowboys got a field goal on the opening drive, and the Eagles came right back and made it 7-3 on Saquon Barkley's eight-yard touchdown run. Barkley returned after missing the last two-plus games with a hamstring injury and had 37 yards rushing on the drive.
Barkley entered with 36 yards rushing all season. He still seemed bothered by the hamstring and had to visit the sideline medical tent. Barkley also missed long stretches getting treatment for his back on the sideline and finished with 62 yards on seven carries.
Prescott threw touchdown passes of nine yards to Lamb and 21 yards to George Pickens that helped the Cowboys stretch their lead to 20-14 at halftime. Pickens' catch was particularly impressive, as he escaped tight coverage by safety Andrew Mukuba in the back of the end zone and dragged his left foot sideways for the score.

Dallas Cowboys
- Passing: Dak Prescott, 15/27, 212 yards, 3 TDs
- Rushing: Javonte Williams, 25 carries, 155 yards, 1 TD
- Receiving: CeeDee Lamb, 5 catches, 74 yards, 2 TDs
Philadelphia Eagles
- Passing: Tanner McKee, 23/35, 211 yards, 1 TD, 1 INT
- Rushing: Saquon Barkley, 7 carries, 62 yards, 1 TD
- Receiving: Makai Lemon, 7 catches, 67 yards, 1 TD

דאלאס קאובויס גברו על פילדלפיה איגלס במשחק שבו הצטיין הקוורטרבק דאק פרסקוט עם 212 יארדים ושלושה טאצ'דאונים, מתוכם שניים לתופס סידי לאב. ג'אבונטה וויליאמס הוסיף שיא קריירה של 155 יארדים בריצה והבטיח את שליטת הקבוצה במגרש.

האיגלס, מצידם, ספגו את הפסדם החמישי ברציפות ונמצאים במשבר עמוק. הקבוצה נאלצת להסתדר ללא הקוורטרבק המוביל שלה ג'יילן הרץ שנעדר עקב קרישי דם בריאות, כאשר המחליף טאנר מקי לא הצליח למנוע את ההפסד המר למרות מאמצי הקבוצה במחצית השנייה.
